data.summary_suggestion: Verify beneficiary eligibility and retrieve account details
data.description_suggestion: Verifies beneficiary eligibility and retrieves account information for LMA account opening or withdrawal requests. Accepts CNIC as query parameter. Returns beneficiary status (active/inactive), existing LMA account status, due amount, mobile number, enrollment date, and unique request identifier. Validates age (18-49), gender (female), and CNIC expiry per business rules. Used by BAFL BVS agents before account opening or payment processing.

data.current_description: After a beneficiary's LMA account is opened at a BAFL BVS agent or through Bulk or through BAFL Branch, BAFL system will call SSPA's Account Opening Update API to share the newly assigned IBAN/Account Number along with associated beneficiary details. SSPA uses this information to reconcile its records and enable subsequent payment processing. BAFL will create and share a code-based district and tehsil library with their mapping IDs from their system, in order to map the IDs with SSPA. This will enable the APIs to exchange only district and tehsil codes instead of names, to avoid mismatch of multiple permutations.
data.summary_suggestion: Register newly opened LMA account with SSPA
data.description_suggestion: Registers a newly opened LMA account with SSPA by submitting IBAN/Account Number and beneficiary details. Accepts request body containing IBAN, Account Number (composite primary key), CNIC, beneficiary name, mobile number, CNIC issuance date, processing mode, and district/tehsil codes (not names). SSPA reconciles records and enables subsequent payment processing. Returns confirmation of account registration. Side effects: Updates SSPA account ledger and enables payment routing to the registered account.
